summary.text: Mike Mrowicki is a Democratic state representative from Vermont's Windham-4 District who has served since 2009 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He is executive director of Putney Family Services.

paragraphs.text: Mike Mrowicki graduated from Neptune High School in 1972.

According to Ballotpedia, he worked as a child care worker for Putney Day Care from 1983 to 1985, as a landscaper and groundskeeper for Putney School from 1989 to 1999, and as a musician with Vermont-Timbre.com since 1972; he has been executive director of Putney Family Services since 1999.
Mrowicki assumed office in the Vermont House in 2009 and served on the Human Services Committee in the early part of his tenure.
In the 2023-2024 session he was assigned to the House Government Operations Committee and the House Sexual Harassment Prevention Panel.
In the November 3, 2026 general election he faces Republican Lynne Wilkins and Ian Diamondstone of the Green Mountain Peace and Justice Party of Vermont.
